BiblicalUsage: The refuge is the city appointed for the manslayer who killed without intent, and the word belongs to the cities of refuge. God told Moses to give six cities where the slayer could flee from the avenger of blood, and Joshua set them apart, three on each side of the Jordan, so that the congregation could judge between the slayer and the avenger.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cities of refuge preach the gospel before the gospel: a man who did not mean to kill could run to safety and live, and the congregation, not the avenger, decided his case. Christ is our city of refuge, and the gate is still open.
